project: SIH26165 — Oil India Limited Precursor Safety Intelligence

sif_binary_classifier.architecture: Trainable Embedding (200) -> Bidirectional GRU (128) -> Softmax Sequence Attention -> Linear (1)
sif_binary_classifier.dataset_provenance: 896 Clean Binary Records (300 IOGP Grounded + 596 Annotated OSHA Contextual Energy)

lsr_multilabel_classifier.architecture: Trainable Embedding (200) -> Bidirectional GRU (128) -> LayerNorm -> Scaled Dot-Product Attention -> 2-Layer MLP Head -> 9 Sigmoids
lsr_multilabel_classifier.class_imbalance_handling: Smooth Square-Root Positive Weighting (w = sqrt(N_neg / N_pos))
lsr_multilabel_classifier.dataset_provenance: 900 Multi-Label Records across 9 Canonical IOGP Rules

target_leakage_protection: Strict narrative-only text input. No metadata, severity, or human rationales enter vectorizer/embedding.
precursor_extraction_status: Precursor dataset verified as decoupled entity strings; sequence token NER deferred pending character-offset annotation.
